title: Copy text to the Wayland clipboard
summary: Use wl-copy to put text into the clipboard on Wayland desktops. You can copy a specific string or pipe the output of a command directly to the clipboard.

aliases.text: скопировать текст в буфер обмена wayland

steps.explain: Copy a specific text string to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: TEXT
placeholders.description: The text you want to copy

alternatives.explain: Pipe the output of a command (like ls) directly to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command whose output you want to copy
